name: host-execution-readiness-probe-launchers
title: Probe canonical host execution readiness and observable launchers
description: Fix the Proof-or-stop gap where host availability proof only checks executable path plus --version. Codex/Claude/agy hosts must also have canonical noninteractive launcher probes that fail fast, expose progress where possible, and catch wrong launcher templates such as agy --prompt-file or Claude stream-json without --verbose before degraded fallback or reviewer dispatch relies on them.
